_inPlaceComment: Required: Stryker's sandbox-mode tsconfig rewriter calls a TypeScript config-parsing API (ts.parseConfigFileTextToJson) that TypeScript 7 removed, crashing before a single mutant runs. inPlace mode skips that preprocessor entirely (it mutates real files directly, one mutant at a time, backing up to .stryker-tmp/ and restoring after every run). Revisit once Stryker ships TS7 support.
